Match the supplied CURRENT character thickness; visible arms/calves are modestly broader than generic wire stickmen, not realistic/muscular bodies. Match the explicitly named identity/age/wardrobe. Do not add a character to a standalone prop or scientific object.
Text: ONLY the exact integrated label requested below, when any. No video caption, script sentence, watermark, signature or extra lower text.
Primary subject/action:
ONE coherent stylized scene: the older gray-haired rounded male stickman matching older-thoughtful.png, in red cardigan/jacket over black tee and red trousers, sits in a compact red armchair, hands resting quietly, staring blankly toward a small BLANK wall picture. The wall picture is a separate simple red rectangular frame fragment within the same illustration; do not fill a room background. Blank distant expression and slightly slumped posture, complete legs and rounded slippers, no realistic human skin, branded hospital, text or extra people.
